candidateMeaning.en: The eastern horizon point used to organize how the chart meets immediate situations and becomes outwardly legible. It is a symbolic interface, not a fixed identity fact.
candidateMeaning.zh-Hans: 东方地平线升起点，用来组织命盘如何进入即时情境、如何被外界看见。它是象征性接口，不是固定人格事实。

candidateMeaning.en: The upper meridian point used to organize public direction, visible contribution and role orientation. It does not guarantee career status or outcomes.
candidateMeaning.zh-Hans: 上中天子午线点，用来组织公共方向、可见贡献与角色取向；它不保证事业地位或结果。

candidateMeaning.en: The western horizon point used to organize one-to-one encounter and reciprocal engagement. It does not describe another person as a fixed type.
candidateMeaning.zh-Hans: 西方地平线下降点，用来组织一对一相遇与互惠互动；它不把他人定义成固定类型。

candidateMeaning.en: The lower meridian point used to organize private foundation, inner base and continuity of belonging. It does not establish family history or fate.
candidateMeaning.zh-Hans: 下中天子午线点，用来组织私人基础、内在根基与归属连续性；它不建立家庭历史或命运事实。
